```{r setup, include=FALSE}

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)

# --------
# Data
# --------

# carica i due indici
mSHI_TLS <- read_csv("C:/Users/rosse/OneDrive/Desktop/Lidar structure/Stat/Results/PCA_Sectors/mSHI_TLS_pop.csv")
mSHI_TLS

SHI_TLS <- read_csv("C:/Users/rosse/OneDrive/Desktop/Lidar structure/Stat/Results/PCA_Sectors/SHI_TLS_scored.csv") 
SHI_TLS

```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)



# -------------------------
# 2) Harmonise names + merge
# -------------------------
idx <- mSHI_TLS %>%
  rename(pop = Pop) %>%
  left_join(SHI_TLS, by = "pop") %>%
  select(pop, median_mSHI, IQR_mSHI, SHI_TLS, SHI_TLS_0_100)

idx

# -------------------------
# 3) Spearman correlation (ranking concordance)
# -------------------------
rho <- cor(idx$median_mSHI, idx$SHI_TLS, method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")
test_rho <- cor.test(idx$median_mSHI, idx$SHI_TLS, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)

rho
test_rho

# Optional: ranks (stand ordering)
idx_ranked <- idx %>%
  mutate(
    rank_mSHI = rank(-median_mSHI, ties.method = "average"),
    rank_SHI  = rank(-SHI_TLS,     ties.method = "average")
  ) %>%
  arrange(rank_mSHI)

idx_ranked

# -------------------------
# 4) Scatter plot (Fig. …)
# -------------------------
p <- ggplot(idx, aes(x = SHI_TLS, y = median_mSHI, label = pop)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_text(nudge_y = 0.05, show.legend = FALSE) +
  labs(
    x = "SHI-TLS (Reich et al., 2021)",
    y = "mSHI-TLS (median per stand)",
    title = "Comparison between SHI-TLS and mSHI-TLS at stand level"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)

p

# Save if needed
ggsave(
  filename = "Fig_indices_comparison_SHI_vs_mSHI.png",
  plot = p, width = 6.5, height = 5.0, dpi = 600
)

```
```{r}
# ---- Merge ----
idx <- mSHI_TLS %>%
  rename(pop = Pop) %>%
  left_join(SHI_TLS, by = "pop") %>%
  mutate(pop = factor(pop, levels = c("FS_HF","PM_R","QC_CP","QC_TR"))) %>%
  arrange(pop)

# ---- Use SHI in 0-100 scale ----
shi_col <- "SHI_TLS_0_100"

# ---- Scaling factor for dual axis ----
scale_factor <- max(idx[[shi_col]], na.rm = TRUE) / max(idx$median_mSHI, na.rm = TRUE)

# ---- Plot ----
p <- ggplot(idx, aes(x = pop)) +

  # SHI-TLS 0-100 (left axis)
  geom_line(aes(y = .data[[shi_col]], colour = "SHI-TLS", group = 1),
            linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(aes(y = .data[[shi_col]], colour = "SHI-TLS"),
             size = 3, shape = 16) +

  # mSHI-TLS (right axis, rescaled)
  geom_line(aes(y = median_mSHI * scale_factor,
                colour = "mSHI-TLS", group = 1),
            linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(aes(y = median_mSHI * scale_factor,
                 colour = "mSHI-TLS"),
             size = 3, shape = 16) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "SHI-TLS (0–100)",
    limits = c(0, 100),
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . / scale_factor, name = "mSHI-TLS")
  ) +

  scale_colour_manual(
    name = NULL,
    values = c("SHI-TLS" = "black",
               "mSHI-TLS" = "grey")
  ) +

  labs(x = "Forest Stands") +

  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(face = "plain"),
    axis.title.y.left  = element_text(face = "plain"),
    axis.title.y.right = element_text(face = "plain"),
    axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
    axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "black"),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11)
  )

# ---- Save ----
ggsave(
  filename = "Index_a.png",
  plot = p,
  path = "C:/Users/rosse/OneDrive/Desktop/Lidar structure/Stat/Results/PCA_Sectors",
  width = 7,
  height = 4,
  dpi = 1200
)

p



```
